messages:
Mina Patel: Heads up — Skyline renewal packet just came in. They returned the vendor risk form + DPA with a BYO-KMS question. Flagging for triage. Renewal window in ~3 weeks, need confirmed answers by EoW next week. Who can own?

Ethan Cruz: @Mina I can take the KMS / BYOK parts. Quick clarifying Q: do they mean full production BYOK or just customer-managed keys for non-prod? The form is vague.

Priya Sengupta: I can map the evidence and call out gaps. Need SOC2 scoping note and environment list from product to confirm what we can supply.

Mina Patel: They explicitly wrote: 'customer-managed keys for embeddings and non-prod'. Screenshot attached in the intake (see upload). Also asked about embeddings retention and whether we delete vectors on request.

SecurityBot: New file uploaded: /shared/evidence/skyline/kyc_bundle_1718005000.zip (contains SOC2 excerpt, DPA redline, vendor_form_filled.pdf)

Liam O'Connor: For embeddings retention: default behavior is 30 days for cache, 365 days for long-term storage unless customer requests otherwise. We can offer 90 days for a renewal concession. Note: Dedicated supports BYOK via KMS integration out of the box; Hosted supports envelope-key BYOK patterns but requires an onboarding ticket.

Ethan Cruz: Action items I propose: 1) Draft BYOK FAQ and KMS attestation (ETA Wed), 2) Fill vendor form answers for key management (ETA Tue EOD), 3) Draft redlines for DPA if needed. @Priya can you confirm current contract type (Hosted vs Dedicated) in account metadata?

Mina Patel: They're on Hosted and currently only using embeddings for search. I checked account settings. I'll ping the customer to confirm whether the request is prod BYOK or non-prod-only.

Priya Sengupta: Mapping done — dropping dataflow snapshot here.

```
Dataflow snapshot for skyline:
/accounts/skyline/env:
  prod: hosted
  embeddings_retention_days: 365
  uses_byo_kms: false
```

Mina Patel: If they only need BYOK for non-prod we can scope an addendum. I'll offer a temporary 30-day renewal extension while we finish tech/legal work. :crossed_fingers:

Liam O'Connor: Heads up — if they insist on Hosted prod BYOK we need an enterprise onboarding (extra legal review + infra change). That will likely push the renewal beyond their window.

Ethan Cruz: I'll upload draft answers to the vendor form and initial DPA redline by EOD Tue. @Mina please cc Legal on any DPA changes beyond our standard.

Mina Patel: Perfect. I'll schedule a quick sync with Skyline for Thu 10am PT and send the invite. Adding follow-up items: owner=Ethan (KMS/DPA), Priya (evidence map), Liam (ops impact & retention options).

Priya Sengupta: Noted, I'll attach the evidence mapping doc to the thread after I clean it up.

Mina Patel: Thanks team — will report back after the customer call.
